card.line: Siloam was a pool near Jerusalem, and its name means "Sent." Jesus sent a blind man there to wash, and the man came back seeing.

moments.title: The tower of Siloam falls
moments.text: Eighteen people in Jerusalem were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them. Jesus used this to teach that everyone needs to repent.

moments.title: A blind man washes and sees
moments.text: Jesus put mud on a blind man's eyes and told him to wash in the Pool of Siloam. The man went, washed, and came back seeing.
